thread:
Alexa (CS): heads-up — we need a quick sync on the dedicated pool handover for Polaris. focus: quota hedging, autoscale windows, and a short ballast/surge rehearsal. who can join a 30m?
Jin (SRE): I can. want to validate that our autoscaler hits target before we shift live traffic. small smoke + 5min burst then steady shadow.
Marco (Eng-Platform): ok, propose window 2024-07-31 03:00-03:30 UTC to avoid peak. I'll reserve GPUs and set a conservative slot policy.
Samir (CS): Polaris requested no tests during their regional business hours (US ET 9-5). that window works. also capture any error-rate deltas so we can show them post-run.
Alexa (CS): perfect. Jin — can you share the load script and the key metrics we'll surface for the customer and renewal play?
Jin (SRE): putting script here, simple ramp + ballistic spike:
```bash
# run on perf-runner
python loadgen.py --target-rps 120 --ramp 300 --spike 800 --duration 900 --model rdx-v2-small
```
Metrics: p50/p95 latency, token/sec, GPU util, queue depth, inference errors, evicted-kv-cache events.
Marco (Eng-Platform): I'll patch the autoscaler policy to include a 2-min cool-down and a headroom fudge factor of 1.25. also enable prefix cache warmup for the slot.
Samir (CS): can we tag the run with the account id + run id so ops/finance can map cost delta? e.g., tag=polaris-20240731-b1
OpsBot: slot_allocated: pool-polaris-01 GPU:8 reserved by Marco. allocation_ts=1719995200
Jin (SRE): thanks OpsBot. quick note: during the spike we may see transient 429s from the ingress path — add soft-fallback to rdx-v2-mid for degraded p95.
Alexa (CS): agree. Samir pls coordinate a short enablement deck for Polaris CS (2 slides) to explain observed behavior and fallbacks — this helps renewal conversations.
Samir (CS): on it. will include: what we tested, observed deltas, recommended rollout cadence, and cost delta summary.
Marco (Eng-Platform): I'll run a dry-run at small scale (10% traffic) an hour before the full rehearsal and post the dry-run logs to the thread.
Jin (SRE): checklist for rehearsal: 1) reserve GPUs (done), 2) deploy autoscaler tweak (Marco), 3) load script staged (me), 4) tagging enabled (Samir), 5) alerting threshold set (p95 > 1200ms) (me).
Alexa (CS): meeting invite sent for 03:00 UTC. goal: finish with an artifacts folder + quick summary for Polaris and renewal team. thanks all — keep this thread for run notes and postmortem bullet points. :thumbsup:
